original_requirement: TODO21: return-type / parameter-type edges for type-boundary reasoning and what flows into a method.

Type-definition links are syntax/name candidates, not semantic compiler proof. Unsupported/constructed references and VB fallback can remain unbound while preserving their authored expressions.
Overload acceptance covers distinct declaration source lines using the existing graph identity; the preexisting same-name/same-line identity limitation is not claimed repaired.
No independent external review, production reindex or full backlog completion claim.
